paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Midrash Tehillim 78:11; he reports that the Yalkut there reads: “R' Berekhyah said, R' Chanina bar Ika said.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The OYW digital Midrash Tehillim 78 paragraph beginning אשר שמענו ונדעם, stored paragraph 7, has Rabbi Berekhyah bar Chanina in Rabbi Yehudah’s name, without Ika in that paragraph. Hyman’s 78:11 locator and his separate report of the Yalkut chain are retained; the Yalkut passage has not been inspected here.

The actual whole OYW Midrash Tehillim 78 stored paragraph 7 begins ישלח בהם ערוב, rather than the opening quoted in the earlier retained note. It has abbreviated R' Berekhyah bar Chanina in R' Yehudah’s name, without Ika in that clause. The heading therefore uses R'; the separate Yalkut chain is Hyman’s uncollated report with R' titles, and “said” is kept distinct from “son of.” Hyman’s 78:11 locator and all earlier notes remain intact; this digital comparison establishes no printed correction history or genealogy.
